Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SPECIAL CONDITIONS Part-I 1.0 The contractor should provide all safety appliances, hand lamps and torch lights required for the workm en on his own and the workmen should follow NLCIL safety rules and regulations strictly & scrupulous sly . 2.0 Skilled Workers having exclusively adequate experience in lifting and erecting of heavy materials are to be engaged independently for ESP 3.0 Necessary Gate pass approval for men and material shall be obtained well in advance from concerned d epartment - HOHR/ TPS2E/NLCIL. 4.0 Work has to be carried out round the clock. Shift timing has to be followed as per NLCIL engineer's instr uctions according to the site conditions and the contractor has to arrange the necessary entry passes for the workmen. 5.0 Readiness of the work front will be intimated one week in advance. 6.0 The Contractor has to strictly adhere to the time frame set by the NLCIL Engineers for each work fronts i n ESP 7.0 The contractor should engage qualified /certified Electricians in each shift to take care of electrical fittin gs, connections and electrical machines /equipments. 8.0 The contractor should engage independent & separate groups for simultaneously execution of works in ESP. 9.0 The contractor should submit the daily labour report (DLR) in triplicate to the NLCIL shift in-charge in ev ery shift beginning. 10.0 The following tools and tackles are strictly under the scope of the Contractor and should be available at site as and when required. The quantities mentioned, if any, are just indicative and the Contractor should arrange any additional requirement in short duration. 10.1 Required spanners (ring, double end and box spanners) 10.2 Cutting torch, regulators and keys (minimum 5 sets) 10.3 Gas cutting Hoses for Oxygen and Acetylene — Not less than 200 meters each. 10.4 Welding cable 500 Mtrs. 10.5 Required numbers of Electrode Oven 10.6 Welding Shields, Holders and goggles (each 10 Nos.) 10.7 Sledge hammers - 10 lbs 10.8 Chain pulley blocks of capacity lT with 5-20m lift, 2T with 5-20m lift, and 5T with 3-7m lift along with suitable D shackles and wire rope slings — each fi Nos.

10.9 Canvas slings of various capacity up to 10 T for lifting of materials. 10.10 Electrically operated portable rope hoist of 2T capacity with height of lifting 20 - 25m. 10.11 Small and Medium Size Platform trolleys- each 2 Nos. 10.12 l Rubber hose for water washing - (COM length - 3/4" size capable of withstanding a water press ure of 10 KSC) — 2 Nos. 10.13 Manila rope 1" - 40 Mts. 10.14 Torch lights 10.15 24V transformer with accessories for hand lamps. 10.16 3 phase welding machines (minimum 5 numbers) 10.17 Adequate numbers of Safety belts. 10.18 Safety barricades are to be provided by the contractor in the required areas/ locations. 11.0 Any other tools required for the works are to be provided by the Contractor. The above tools and tackles should be checked in with necessary endorsement of Security Officer/TPS2E after issue of LOA. The sam e endorsed documents should be handed over to the NLCIL engineers. 12.0 Storing and safeguarding the Tools and tackles are under Contractor's scope. 13.0 Necessary scaffolding platforms with suitable fixtures are to be arranged by the Contractor, whenever a nd wherever required during the execution of works. 14.0 The following materials and consumables will be provided at free of cost by NLCIL. The loss or damage t o the items will be recovered from the contractor's running bill. 14.1 Electricity, compressed air & water. 14.2 M.S. Plates, angles, channels, pipes, I beam required for the works and required spares of ESP. 15.0 The following materials and consumables will be Scope of contractor. 15.1 Cutting gas (Oxygen and Acetylene (DA)) 15.2 Welding electrodes 15.3 Any Rust lone and other consumables 16.0 Necessary additional and special tools & tackles, if any, may be issued at the discretion of NLCIL engine ers to expedite and complete the works at the earliest and are to be returned to NLCIL immediately after completion of work. 17.0 Transport facilities such as Lorry, Cranes, Tractors and etc., is in the scope of the contractor. 18.0 The non-availability of front, for the reasons such as equipment stoppage not available and etc. will not be attributed to contractor's account. 19.0 The food and Canteen facilities are under the scope of the contractor and NLCIL will not extend any facili ty in this regard. 20.0 The Contractor should arrange additional skilled workforce whenever required; as per the instructions of NLCIL Engineers, in a very short period. 21.0 Work place and fabrication area should always be kept neat and easily accessible. The scraps and wast e materials collected should be transported and disposed to the designated places after completion of w orks, immediately. 22.0 The contractor shall engage minimum of ONE number of supervisors per shift. Part-II 1.0 SUPERVISOR CHARGES – PENALTY CLAUSE 1.1 In case the specified site supervisor is not engaged by the contractor for the days as per site requi rement, then a penalty of 1.5 times of the supervisory charges shall be deducted from the bill s of the contractor on pro-rata attendance basis. 1.2 The attendance details of the supervisors shall be maintained with the signature of the supervisor , countersigned by the Contractor as well as the NLCIL official concerned. 1.3 Payment of wages to the supervisor and PF and other statutory remittance, if applicable, will be in the scope of the Contractor. 2.0 Tools & tackles, lifting machines & Safety appliances that are used for the work or by the workmen shou ld posses ISI mark and valid test certificate from the competent authority. 3.0 The Contractor should observe all safety rules and regulations in force and ensure that all necessary saf ety precautions are followed up strictly for the safety of workers engaged in the work. 4.0 The Contractor should engage adequate man power having appropriate skills with the approval of the N LCIL officials to carryout and complete the works. Any extra time / over time engagement of the man po wer shall be the contractor’s responsibility. 5.0 RATE OF WAGES The present rates of wages payable to various categories of contract workers and Supervisor are as belo w:

TABLE Wages to be paid Total wages Category Dearness allowance-(DA Rate of wages ) w.e.f 01.04.2026 (Rs. per day) (Rs. per day) (Rs. per day) USK 350.00 206 556 SSK / Supe 410.00 240 650 rvisor SK 494.00 287 781 HSK 579.00 339 918 6.0 RATE OF WAGES / DA PAYABLE TO THE WORKMEN The contractor has to pay the rates of wages / DA as per Table above as announced by NLCIL and any re vision of rates of wages / DA from time to time. However, in case of any revision of rates of wages / DA n otified during contract period, the contractor shall pay the same along with P.F. & ESI component for the various categories of labour component. 7.0 RATE REVISION (NOT APPLICABLE). 8.0 CONTRACT WORKMEN DEATH RELIEF FUND (CWDF) 8.1 An amount equivalent to 0.2% (zero point two percent) of gross value of every bill payable (befor e statutory, non statutory deductions) shall be deducted towards “Contract Workmen Death Relief Fund” (CWDF) from the contractors for the works carried out by the contractor. No provision has b een made in the estimate towards the above deduction. 8.2 Based on the modified DRF scheme, monthly contributions to the death relief fund of Contract Wo rkmen / Supervisors shall be deducted by the Contractor Employers concerned @ Rs.25/- from eve ry contract workman / Supervisors engaged by Contractor Employer for the works in NLCIL from th eir salary /wages payable. In order to facilitate this, necessary deduction will be made from the bill s of the Contractor employers based on Form - D (Attendance Register) & Form -B (Wage Register) Equal monthly contribution to the fund @ Rs.25/- per contract workman / Supervisors will be made by the Principal Employer NLCIL i.e. the Concerned Unit Head / Unit Accounts Centre. 9.0 CONTRACT WORKMAN AGE The contractor shall not engage workmen beyond 60 years and the Contractor shall also produce the req uired age proof for the workmen engaged by him, while applying for entry permit for first time. 10.0 ESI & EPF The Contractor Employers shall be required to undertake the responsibility of remit ting the contribution/ subscription etc., of the contract workman engaged by them t owards EPF (EPF & EDLI), ESI etc., (as applicable) and NLCIL as the principal employ er, will ensure compliance under the relevant applicable statutes by verifying the re mittance made by the Contractor Employers before releasing part / final bills. 11.0 BONUS The contractor shall ensure payment of minimum bonus of 8.33% of the annual wages to the contract wo rkmen engaged by them for more than 30 days subject to the wages ceiling as provided under Payment of Bonus Act, 1965 and failure in this regard will be treated as violation of the terms of the contract.

12.0 SAFETY Personal protective equipments (PPE)ie like Helmet, Safety shoe, Goggles etc by to be provided by the c ontractor and it is in the scope of the contractor. 13.0 PRICE REDUCTION CLAUSE Time is the essence of the contract. In case the contractor fails to complete the works within the stipulate d period (as per Cl.No.16.2 of Part-II Special Conditions), then, unless such a failure is due to Force Majeure or due to Purchaser’s defaults, the total contract price shall be reduced by ½% (half percent) of the total contract price per day of delay or part thereof subject to a maximum of 5% of the total contract price, by way of reduction in price for delay and not as penalty. 14.0 GUARANTEE FOR WARRANTY Not Applicable 15.0 CONTRACT PERFORMANCE GUARANTEE Not Applicable 16.0 PERIOD OF CONTRACT 16.1 11 Months from service start date as per GeM contract. Note: Lead days of 7 days are provided to the Service Provider for necessary mobilization for offering ser vice. Thus the service start date will commence from minimum 7 days after contract generation da te. 16.2 WORK PERIOD: The period of work is 25 days from the date of handing over of the site. (Work has to be taken simu ltaneously for A and B passes in unit and completed within 25 days) The works has to be carried ou t during the shutdown and works has to be carried out in three shifts. The firm should be able to pr ovide quicker delivery in case of any emergency requirement to NLC. However, the contractor will be permitted to carry out preparatory work before handover of site. 17.0 PAYMENT TERMS Part bill will be permitted on monthly basis for the completed work in that month aft er producing required Documents and invoice. Final bill will be paid after getting fin alization order. Bills will be paid within 30Days after accepting the Invoice. 18.0 GST (Goods and Service Tax) Contractor has to furnish the GST Registration number with relevant documenta ry evidence. Contractor has to comply with the GST Act/ Rules. 19.0 NLCIL reserves the right to short close / extend the contract due to special circumstances. ***** . 3.
